title: Genny H NDE 7462
content: When I had my experience, I was in major surgery due to blood clots and an aneurysm. I was not conscious at the time. But, I do remember hearing my grandson's voice, right before I was taken to heaven. He said he wanted to talk to nanny for the last time. I remember he told me that he was going to marry his girlfriend and wanted me to be the first one to know, even though I was unconscious. Everyone thought I was dying and the doctors had called the family in to see me one last time. My daughter and her husband, who is a minister, said they knew I was dying and assumed this was the last time they would see me alive. When my experience began, I remember being out of my body and floating over the most beautiful flowers I had ever seen. I saw colors that can't be describe because they just don't exist on earth. All of the colors were very radiant and vibrant. I saw trees, beautiful rivers and streams. There was a river with trees on either side of it. I remember being taken aback by how beautiful everything was. I was very happy because I knew I was on my way to heaven. While I was taking in all of this scenery, I felt like I was almost in a trance. Suddenly, out of no where, a face appeared to me from inside a doorway, or maybe a window. I only saw this person from the waist up. I knew immediately it was Jesus Christ himself! Let me tell you, he does not look like the pictures and paintings we have of him. I have never told anyone about his exact appearance, but if he appeared at my door I would know him. I will say that he has a medium skin tone and dark hair. He looked very kind, loving, and fairly young. Jesus was calling my name. I answered him and said, 'I know I'm in heaven.' He said, 'My child, I can not let you come in.' I asked, 'Why?' I was trying to argue with him. I told him, 'I'm 77 years old. Why can't I come in?' He answered with, 'My child, I have more work on earth for you to do for me.' I asked, 'Why?' again. But that's all he said to me. He did tell me he was going to send me back to the work he had for me to do. When I woke up I saw my daughter and another person at the end of my bed praying. I closed my eyes and opened them again and two people were still there. My daughter was praying and asking God to keep here on earth, that she didn't want me to die. She said she still needed her mother. When I opened and then closed my eyes for the third time, there was only one person standing there, my daughter. Later on, my daughter told me there was no one whatsoever in the room at that time besides her. I believe it was an angel.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: She identified the being as “Jesus Christ himself,” seen from the waist up in a doorway/window; medium skin tone, dark hair, kind/loving, fairly young; calling her name and speaking with her.
arrival.other_being_detail: After awakening, she saw her daughter and “another person” praying at the foot/end of the bed; later her daughter said no one else was present; experiencer believed it was an angel.

environment.environment_other_detail: “Most beautiful flowers,” radiant/vibrant colors “that don't exist on earth,” trees, “beautiful rivers and streams,” and a river with trees on either side.

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Jesus told her: “My child, I have more work on earth for you to do for me,” and that he was going to send her back to that work.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Major surgery due to blood clots and an aneurysm.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Heard grandson’s voice while unconscious before the experience; after awakening, saw an additional person praying who was later reported by daughter to not have been present (interpreted as an angel).
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with immediate entry into a beautiful heavenly environment; boundary/doorway encounter with Jesus and being told she could not enter; then return/awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Heard grandson speaking to her while she was unconscious prior to the OBE/heavenly scene; post-awakening perception of an extra praying person later denied by daughter, interpreted by experiencer as an angel.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “My child, I can not let you come in.” / “My child, I have more work on earth for you to do for me.” / “I know I'm in heaven.”
